issues.title: Swept claim reservation strands governed execution failure finalization
issues.reproducer: Claim a work, allow its side-effect-free claim-reservation RunAttempt to be swept, then run a failing work advance --execute; automatic failed close rejects the abandoned claim attempt and leaves the work running.

Close and ProofChainDoctor treated replacement history as outcome-neutral only for completed work; a later failed harness result therefore hit abandoned-versus-failed rejection before terminal publication. The replacement relation also needed exact result-ownership evidence: committed launch or rooted prepared+start_error, never origin alone.

issues.title: Isolated release certifier
issues.reproducer: Run the future certifier from a clean candidate with temporary install root and COMPOUND_HOME; no such command exists yet.
issues.root_cause: The current release workflow is tag-triggered and release-smoke is an operator-estate diagnostic, not an isolated certifier.
issues.invariant: One candidate-first command and PR/manual workflow prove all supported journeys and emit a machine-readable evidence manifest before tagging.
issues.red_test: Isolated certifier integration suite not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: Correctness is currently discovered across disconnected gates, some only after a tag trigger.

issues.title: Opted-in delegate mutation TOCTOU and crash atomicity
issues.reproducer: With --experimental-delegate-mutations enabled, race authority drift around external session create/send and inject failure between refusal event, binding, lifecycle, and RunAttempt publication.
issues.root_cause: The experimental delegate path spans an external session side effect plus several durable authorities without one recoverable transaction covering every post-create and post-send boundary.
issues.invariant: Before delegated mutation becomes supported, every external side effect is generation-bound, exactly reported, and either committed with matching authority or left with durable idempotent recovery evidence.
issues.red_test: Opted-in cross-process TOCTOU and every-boundary failure-injection suite not yet established.
focused_tests: Default-off and malformed/unadmitted containment is green at 225d6969; this does not certify opted-in mutation.
issues.residual_risk: Explicitly outside the supported v0.1 contract behind --experimental-delegate-mutations. Consequence is limited to operators who opt into the experimental path; post-release milestone is v0.2 delegated-execution recovery hardening.

issues.title: Target-scoped proof chain omits RunAttempt validation
issues.reproducer: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.4 go test -count=1 ./internal/work -run '^TestProofChainForWorkRejectsMissingRunAttempt$' -v
issues.root_cause: ProofChainForWork calls proofChainItem and marks a problem-free item complete without calling checkRunAttemptProof. Commit a329dad7 added the RunAttempt proof dimension only to the whole-ledger ProofChainDoctor, so target-scoped consumers retain the pre-v0.2 behavior.
issues.invariant: Every target-scoped terminal proof applies the same canonical RunAttempt identity, work/action linkage, terminal status/outcome, retry-lineage, and exact terminalization checks as the whole-ledger doctor while reading only the requested work and its referenced evidence.
issues.red_test: TestProofChainForWorkRejectsMissingRunAttempt
issues.residual_risk: Until fixed, authority worktree-retire can plan and revalidate an operator-reviewed Git mutation from a false-green source proof whose referenced RunAttempt is missing, unreadable, invalid, cross-work/action, nonterminal, outcome-inconsistent, or terminalization-mismatched. Legacy OS-absorption work-packet auto-proof can likewise false-green, but that consumer is explicitly experimental/private. The supported v0.1 core work journey and whole-ledger proof-chain doctor are not affected.

issues.title: Owner-result binding
issues.reproducer: Supply wrong schema, plan ID, owner, artifact, freshness, uniqueness, and domain-success facts to owner-result folding.
issues.root_cause: Exact owner-result binding has not yet been reconciled against the release contract.
issues.invariant: A result closes or files a plan only when every identity, provenance, freshness, uniqueness, and success fact matches.
issues.red_test: Owner-result mismatch matrix not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: A semantically unrelated result can satisfy a plan-shaped record.

issues.title: Shell contract
issues.reproducer: Execute adapters/_lib/lane-launcher.sh under its declared interpreter and a strict shell validator.
issues.root_cause: The launcher declares sh while using non-POSIX syntax.
issues.invariant: Every shell file executes and validates under the interpreter it declares.
issues.red_test: Declared-interpreter shell contract test not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: The launcher can fail on systems whose sh is not a permissive shell.

issues.title: Audit package hygiene
issues.reproducer: Force-track a forbidden top-level runtime checkout in a fixture and require the public exporter to refuse it.
issues.root_cause: Current Git-archive export is clean, but explicit allowlist or denial coverage for stale nested runtime/source surfaces is incomplete.
issues.invariant: Public export includes only the supported source allowlist and cannot package nested source checkouts or runtime state.
issues.red_test: Forbidden tracked top-level surface export test not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: A future force-tracked home or nested checkout could enter an otherwise Git-based export.
